Subject: GO+ launch: owner rollcall, enablement gaps, and QBR artifact ask

Team —

Quick leadership pulse as we head into the final two weeks before the GO+ public launch. I need a short, actionable rollcall from each function by EOD tomorrow so we can finalize the QBR packet and the exec readout on Monday. Please reply inline to the items assigned to you below.

High-level asks (please be concise):
- Owners: confirm primary owner + backup for GTM, enablement, pricing, docs, support readiness.
- Readiness score: green / amber / red + top 1 blocker.
- QBR artifacts: flag any data or collateral you need to include (we'll use the attached QBR template).
- If you need pricing exceptions or legal input, call it out now so we can brief finance/legal.

I’ve attached the current Playbook (GOplus_launch_playbook_v2.pdf) and the QBR template. Below are my initial notes — please update.

1) GTM (Marissa) — current ask: final battlecards and field-facing demo recordings.
2) Enablement (Karthik) — current ask: train-the-trainer sessions + closed caption scripts for EU regions.
3) Pricing (Ben) — current ask: confirm discount guardrails and list of customer exceptions.
4) Docs (Laura) — current ask: final product docs + release notes + migration how-to.
5) Support readiness (Marissa + external Support Ops) — runbook for common escalations + SLA fallback.

Please keep replies tight — one-line owner + readiness + one blocker + artifact request.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Head of GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
